summary: Steel lookout in Lee County, KY, first observed by federal surveyors in 1951; listed as removed, and no source describes the site today.

facts.design: Four-legged steel tower with an observation room on top, painted gray
facts.status_note: Listed as removed; no source describes what remains at the site.
facts.agency: State (only as the index label 'Lee County - State'; the source does not explain it)

events.note: Coast and Geodetic Survey first observed the station and described the tower

evidence.supports: first observed by the Coast and Geodetic Survey in 1951
four-legged steel structure 80 feet high, observation room on top, painted gray
evidence.quote: THE STATION IS A 4-LEGGED STEEL STRUCTURE 80 FEET HIGH WITH AN OBSERVATION ROOM ATOP PAINTED GRAY

evidence.supports: survey line of about 27 feet from triangulation station Bear Track to the tower base
evidence.quote: A TRAVERSE CONNECTION WAS MADE FROM TRIANGULATION STATION BEAR TRACK AND THE DISTANCE WAS FOUND TO BE 8.373 METERS (27.47 FEET)

evidence.supports: the survey point observed from the traverse is the center of the tower's base
evidence.quote: THE POINT TRAVERSED TO AND OBSERVED ON WAS THE CENTER OF THE BASE OF THE LOOKOUT TOWER

evidence.supports: directions end at the top of a hill reached by a gravel road
evidence.quote: TURN RIGHT ON GRAVEL ROAD AND GO 0.25

evidence.supports: directions end at the top of a hill
evidence.quote: GO UP HILL FOR 0.2 MILE TO THE TOP OF HILL AND THE STATION AS DESCRIBED

evidence.supports: Lee County; owner listed as State
survey record still lists the station with a current position; does not say whether the tower stands

sources.title: Survey mark GY3343, Bear Track Lookout Tower

notes_for_editor: Only three pages describe Bear Track: the Forest Lookouts page (copied from the NGS survey description), the NGS datasheet GY3343, and the index. The record's coordinates agree with the NGS position (37.6255 N, 83.7721 W). Height 80 ft is converted to 24.4 m; the record had no height. The label 'State' comes only from the index entry 'Lee County - State' and is not explained further, so the story quotes the label and does not call it an owner. A search snippet from Natural Atlas called the tower a Daniel Boone National Forest lookout; the page we could read did not say that, so it is not used. The NGS description dates from 1951 and gives no construction date, so no built event is recorded. No source gives a removal date or cause. The site's public access is unknown.
